name: Calendar / Release Deadline
description: Release Deadline product scenario for the Calendar component.

controls.name: viewDate
controls.description: Displayed month as YYYY-MM-DD, independently of selection.

controls.name: defaultViewDate
controls.description: Initial displayed month as YYYY-MM-DD; read only on initialization.

controls.name: min
controls.description: Earliest selectable civil date, inclusive, as YYYY-MM-DD.

controls.name: max
controls.description: Latest selectable civil date, inclusive, as YYYY-MM-DD.

controls.name: disabledDates
controls.description: Unavailable civil dates as YYYY-MM-DD strings.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disable date selection and month navigation; remove internal controls from Tab.

controls.name: readOnly
controls.description: Prevent user selection while keeping focus and month navigation available.

controls.name: locale
controls.description: Date formatting language, numbering system and default first weekday; dates stay Gregorian.

controls.name: labels
controls.description: Internal navigation labels; use aria-label/aria-labelledby to name the calendar group.

controls.name: weekStartsOn
controls.description: Override the locale's first weekday: 0=Sunday through 6=Saturday.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Accessible name of the calendar group; the inner grid is named by its displayed month.

controls.name: aria-labelledby
controls.description: External label IDs for the calendar group; takes precedence over aria-label.

controls.name: aria-describedby
controls.description: External description IDs for the calendar group.

controls.name: selection
controls.description: Select one day, or a range from a start day to an end day.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Selected day or range as YYYY-MM-DD; null clears the controlled value.

controls.name: defaultValue
controls.description: Initial uncontrolled day or range as YYYY-MM-DD.

controls.name: excludeDisabledDates
controls.description: Exclude unavailable days from the whole range; false constrains only its endpoints.
